role: a seismologist analyzing three-component broadband seismic waveforms
subject: a 60-second three-component (E, N, Z) seismogram sampled at 100 Hz (a 3 x 6000 array) recorded at a broadband seismic station (the STEAD catalogue)
property: ground-motion amplitude over time on three orthogonal components; each trace is catalogued as either a local earthquake or ambient/background noise (the 'label' field), earthquake traces additionally carry source magnitude, epicentral distance (km) and source depth (km), and every trace carries station network, station code and instrument channel metadata
request: Each file is a 60-second, three-component (E, N, Z) broadband seismogram sampled at 100 Hz, stored as a 3 x 6000 array, recorded at a seismic station (the STEAD catalogue). This set of about 1500 traces is a balanced mix of local earthquakes and ambient/background noise (see each member's 'label'); earthquake traces carry source magnitude, epicentral distance and depth, and every trace carries station network, station and channel metadata. Find a concrete, novel, testable question this data can answer, decide your own method, run real code on the waveforms, and produce a short publishable paper.

_demo.purpose: interface and perception smoke test; not the full paper evaluation
